class.name: NetwRingBuffer
class.brief_description: Pre-allocated ring buffer that stores values keyed by tick number.

method.name: bracketing_ticks
method.description: Returns the [code](prev, next)[/code] ticks bracketing [param tick]. [code]x[/code] is the greatest recorded tick less than or equal to [param tick] or [code]-1[/code] if none exists. [code]y[/code] is the smallest recorded tick strictly greater than [param tick] or [code]-1[/code] if none exists.

method.name: clear
method.description: Drops every recorded entry, keeping the allocated capacity.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a buffer holding at least [param capacity] entries, rounded up to a power of two. Calling [code]new()[/code] instead gives the default capacity.

method.name: get_at
method.description: Returns the value recorded at exactly [param tick], or [code]null[/code] when that tick was never recorded or has since been evicted.

method.name: has_tick_after
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when at least one entry is recorded strictly after [param tick].

method.name: newest_tick
method.description: Returns the most recently recorded tick, or [code]-1[/code] when the buffer is empty.

method.name: oldest_tick
method.description: Returns the oldest tick still held, or [code]-1[/code] when the buffer is empty.

method.name: record
method.description: Records [param value] at [param tick]. Recording past capacity evicts the oldest entry.

method.name: size
method.description: Returns how many entries are recorded.
